day4_night_start.name: Me
day4_night_start.text: *Back home. Lying in bed, today's memories replay like a film reel.*

day4_night_yuna_sneak.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_sneak.text: *10 PM. A message from Yuna. 'School back gate. Come now.'*

day4_night_yuna_sneak_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_sneak_2.text: *My heart is pounding. The 'truth' Yuna mentioned -- am I finally going to find out?*

day4_night_yuna_arrive_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_arrive_2.text: *The school back gate. Yuna was standing under a streetlight. Her expression harder than usual.*

day4_night_yuna_wall.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall.text: "...Before we go in, there's something you need to see first. This way."

day4_night_yuna_wall_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_2.text: *Yuna led me behind the building. A dark corner with no streetlights. When her flashlight hit the exterior wall -- I saw the crack.*

day4_night_yuna_wall_3.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_3.text: *'Crack' didn't do it justice. A fissure running vertically along the wall, as wide as a forearm. Chunks of concrete had already fallen away.*

day4_night_yuna_wall_4.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_4.text: "This... how long has it been like this?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_5.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_5.text: "At least three years. The school kept delaying repairs. They just blocked students from coming to this side."

day4_night_yuna_wall_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_6.text: "This building had problems from day one. It wasn't built to spec. Rebar spacing, concrete mix ratio -- all below standard."

day4_night_yuna_enter_honest.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_enter_honest.text: "...Be honest. I'm right here with you."

day4_night_yuna_wall_8.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_8.text: "The contractor was 'Sungjin Construction.' The company CEO is the foundation chairman's brother-in-law. Know where 700 million out of 1.5 billion won in construction costs went?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_10.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_10.text: "Into the foundation's accounts. They siphoned the construction money and did shoddy work. This crack is the proof. The entire building is unsafe."

day4_night_yuna_wall_11.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_11.text: *I looked at the crack again. This wasn't just wear and tear. Hundreds of students were inside this building every single day. That fact suddenly felt crushing.*

day4_night_yuna_wall_choice.name: Me
choices: "...The school knew about this and covered it up? How is that even possible?"
"...Is this something we should even be touching?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_anger.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_anger.text: "...Anger alone won't cut it. We need evidence. It's downstairs. Follow me."

day4_night_yuna_wall_fear.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_wall_fear.text: "...Being scared is natural. I spent a whole year feeling the same way. But you've already seen it. Can you pretend you haven't?"

day4_night_yuna_wall_end.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_wall_end.text: *Yuna's words hit deep. I can't pretend I don't know. I've already seen this crack with my own eyes.*

day4_night_yuna_choice.name: Me
choices: "Of course. That's why I came."
"...Honestly, I'm a little scared."

day4_night_yuna_corridor.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_corridor.text: *Yuna opened the back gate lock with practiced hands. She'd clearly done this many times before.*

day4_night_yuna_corridor_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_corridor_2.text: *The empty school hallway. Only dim emergency lights. The daytime noise completely gone, like even breathing would echo.*

day4_night_yuna_corridor_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_corridor_3.text: "...The underground archives. A section the school sealed off. Everything's down here."

day4_night_yuna_basement.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_basement.text: *Going underground, the air turned cold. The smell of dust mixed with old paper.*

day4_night_yuna_basement_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_basement_2.text: "This school's foundation, 'Sungjin Academy.' Prestigious on the surface. Behind the scenes, they've been running a systematic slush fund for ten years."

day4_night_yuna_basement_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_basement_4.text: "Embezzling student welfare funds, fake facility repair claims, misappropriating donations. It's all here."

day4_night_yuna_documents.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_documents.text: *Yuna pulled a worn file from the shelf. Dense numbers and stamps covering every page. A real ledger.*

day4_night_yuna_documents_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_documents_2.text: "Especially the main building's east staircase. Records say it was renovated three years ago, but in reality, not a single penny was spent."

day4_night_yuna_documents_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_documents_3.text: "...And on those stairs, there was an accident one year ago."

day4_night_yuna_truth_choice.name: Me
choices: "...Who got hurt?"
"Yuna... are you okay?"

day4_night_yuna_senpai_concern.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_concern.text: "...You're the first person to ask me that."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_reveal.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_reveal.text: "...Lee Junho. A senior. He was the student council president at the time. He found out about the foundation's corruption and was gathering evidence."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_2.text: "He had a powerful sense of justice. Almost foolishly so. He could never look away when someone was being wronged."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_3.text: "Then one day... he fell from that east staircase. The school ruled it an 'accidental fall.'"

day4_night_yuna_senpai_4.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_senpai_4.text: "...An accidental fall? The person investigating the corruption?"

day4_night_yuna_senpai_5.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_5.text: "The old staircase railing they never repaired snapped, and he fell. But there was a mark on his head -- like something struck him."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_6.text: "It was the night before he planned to take the evidence to the Board of Education. Coincidence or not."

day4_night_yuna_senpai_death.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_senpai_death.text: "He passed away at the hospital a few days later. Never woke up."

day4_night_yuna_silence.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_silence.text: *Yuna's hands were shaking. Her fingertips gripping the documents had gone white.*

day4_night_yuna_silence_choice.name: Me
choices: Take Yuna's hand
"...Keep talking. I'm listening."

day4_night_yuna_hand_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_hand_2.text: *Yuna's hand was cold. But she didn't pull away.*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro.text: "...And one more thing. This is the most important part."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_intro_2.text: "The foundation's corruption started with the chairman ten years ago. But the last two years are different. More calculated. More systematic."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_4.text: "Seoyeon is the chairman's granddaughter. The Sungjin Academy foundation chairman. The Sungjin Group chairman's granddaughter."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_5.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_5.text: *My mind went blank. Seoyeon, who always smiled so brightly. Those curious eyes. The chairman's granddaughter?*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_6.text: "Student council fund misuse, fraudulent scholarship claims, rigged disciplinary records... everything in the last two years was designed by Seoyeon with the foundation backing her."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_7.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_7.text: "...I can't believe that. Seoyeon isn't that kind of person."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_8.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_8.text: "...I thought the same thing. At first. But look at these documents."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_9.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_9.text: *Yuna handed me a stack of papers. Student council financial reports, scholarship selection lists, disciplinary committee minutes. Every document bore the same signature.*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_10.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_10.text: "Seoyeon used the student council presidency to control the money flow. Perfect student on the surface, doing exactly what the foundation told her behind the scenes."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_11.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_11.text: *The papers in my hands trembled. Seoyeon's smiling face flashed through my mind. Was that effortless smile all an act?*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_12.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_reveal_12.text: "...Whether Seoyeon is a bad person, I honestly don't know. She's been inside that system since birth. But that doesn't make it okay. There are real victims."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_choice.name: Me
choices: "...I want to ask Seoyeon directly."
"...Understood. There's evidence. Let's move forward."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt.text: "Can't do that. Too dangerous. The moment Seoyeon finds out, the evidence could vanish."

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_doubt_2.text: *I knew she was right, but I couldn't easily accept it. Seoyeon's face kept flickering before my eyes.*

day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_bridge.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_seoyeon_bridge.text: *The cold of the basement seeped into my bones. Seoyeon, the foundation, the senior's death, the crack in the wall. It's all connected. And Yuna has been carrying this alone.*

day4_night_yuna_resemblance.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance.text: "...Actually, there's one more thing I need to tell you."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_2.text: "When you first transferred here... I nearly stopped breathing."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_4.text: "You look like Junho. Your eyes, your vibe. Even the way you can't stand by when something's wrong."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_5.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_5.text: "...At first I was scared. Afraid the same thing would repeat. Afraid you'd be in danger too."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_6.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_6.text: "But at the same time... with you beside me, I felt like I could finish what he couldn't."

day4_night_yuna_resemblance_7.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_resemblance_7.text: *So that's why. The reason Yuna showed interest in me from the start. That 'special light' she mentioned -- was it the senior's shadow all along?*

day4_night_yuna_critical_choice.name: Me
choices: "I'm not him. I'm me. But I'll still fight alongside you."
"Even if I'm a stand-in, that's fine. I want to be the person you need."
"...So you approached me because of him? As a replacement?"

day4_night_yuna_moved.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_moved.text: "...I know. You are you. Maybe at first I was chasing his shadow. But now..."

day4_night_yuna_touched.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_touched.text: "...Idiot. You can't just say stuff like that."

day4_night_yuna_touched_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_touched_2.text: "You're not a stand-in. You're already more than enough just being yourself."

day4_night_yuna_confronted_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_confronted_2.text: "...I won't deny it. At first, that's how it was. But spending time together changed that. This is real."

day4_night_yuna_confronted_3.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_confronted_3.text: "...Even if you don't believe me, I'll prove it."

day4_night_yuna_resolve.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve.text: "...I made copies of these documents. The originals stay here."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve_2.text: "What the senior couldn't finish. This time, I'm seeing it through. Reporting to the press and the Board of Education."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_3.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_resolve_3.text: *Determination filled Yuna's eyes. This wasn't curiosity. She'd been digging alone for an entire year.*

day4_night_yuna_resolve_4.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_resolve_4.text: "...It could be dangerous. The foundation won't sit still."

day4_night_yuna_resolve_5.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_resolve_5.text: "Let's do this together. Don't carry it all alone."

day4_night_yuna_exit.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_exit.text: *We slipped out of the school. The night wind was cold, but with Yuna beside me, it didn't bite as much.*

day4_night_yuna_exit_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_exit_2.text: "...Thank you for today. It's the first time I've told anyone what I've been carrying."

day4_night_yuna_exit_choice.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_exit_choice.text: *Under the night sky, Yuna smiled awkwardly.*
choices: "No. Because I got to know you better."
"Next time, let's go on a real date. Like a cafe."

day4_night_yuna_exit_promise.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_exit_promise.text: "A cafe. Sounds good. Can I pick the place this time?"

day4_night_yuna_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_farewell.text: *Yuna started to turn away, then stopped. She gripped my sleeve tight.*

day4_night_yuna_farewell_2.name: Yuna
day4_night_yuna_farewell_2.text: "...Thanks for today. Saying it out loud feels kind of awkward."

day4_night_yuna_home.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_home.text: *Back home. Yuna's cold hand and resolute eyes won't leave my mind.*

day4_night_yuna_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_yuna_home_2.text: *The weight Yuna's been carrying alone. I'm certain now -- I want to share that load.*

day4_night_seoyeon_call_2_normal.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_call_2_normal.text: "...It's me. If you're not busy, could you come out for a bit?"

day4_night_seoyeon_angry_call.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_angry_call.text: "...Why did you lie to me yesterday? I want to talk in person. Can you come out?"

day4_night_seoyeon_call_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_call_3.text: *Seoyeon's voice sounds different. No trace of laughter, and something in it seems to tremble.*

day4_night_seoyeon_call_4.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_call_4.text: "...You know the park near my house? I'll wait there."

day4_night_seoyeon_park.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_park.text: *I arrived at the park. Seoyeon was sitting alone on a bench. Casual clothes instead of her uniform.*

day4_night_seoyeon_park_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_park_2.text: "...You came. Sorry for calling you out so suddenly."

day4_night_seoyeon_park_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_park_3.text: *Seoyeon's eyes are red. Was she crying?*
choices: "What happened? Are you okay?"
Sit next to her without saying anything

day4_night_seoyeon_concern.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_concern.text: "...If I said I was fine, that'd be a lie."

day4_night_seoyeon_silent_sit.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_silent_sit.text: "...Thank you. Just having you next to me -- that's the best thing right now."

day4_night_seoyeon_open.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open.text: "...Mom called today. She and Dad had another fight."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_2.text: "Our house looks fine from the outside, right? Big house, nice car, student council president daughter."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_3.text: "But Mom and Dad have been strangers under the same roof for a year. Just haven't filed the papers."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_5.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_5.text: "Mom told me, 'At least you need to be perfect for this family to hold together.' So student council, grades -- I couldn't let go of any of it."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_6.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_6.text: "'Seoyeon's always so bright,' 'Seoyeon's good at everything.' Those words started to feel like a prison."

day4_night_seoyeon_open_7.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_open_7.text: "I wasn't smiling -- I was 'performing' a smile. Every single day."

day4_night_seoyeon_tear.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_tear.text: *Tears spilled from Seoyeon's eyes. Glistening under the streetlight.*

day4_night_seoyeon_tear_choice.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_tear_choice.text: *Seoyeon is crying. I've never seen this side of her before.*
choices: Hug Seoyeon
Offer a pinky promise

day4_night_seoyeon_hug_2.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_hug_2.text: *Seoyeon buried her face in my chest. Her small shoulders were trembling.*

day4_night_seoyeon_hug_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_hug_3.text: "...It's been so long since I've cried like this. Crying in front of someone -- this is the first time."

day4_night_seoyeon_pinky.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_pinky.text: "I promise. Whenever you need to cry, you can cry to me."

day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_3.text: *Seoyeon linked her trembling pinky with mine. Then the tears she'd been holding back came flooding out.*

day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_4.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_pinky_4.text: "...You idiot, why are you so good to me..."

day4_night_seoyeon_real.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_real.text: "...Even during our date today, I was scared. Am I allowed to be this happy. What if this all falls apart too."

day4_night_seoyeon_real_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_real_2.text: "Are you... okay with a me that's not perfect?"

day4_night_seoyeon_real_choice.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_real_choice.text: *Seoyeon is looking up at me with trembling eyes.*
choices: "I like this Seoyeon more than the perfect version."
"Not the student council president Seoyeon -- just Seoyeon is my girlfriend."
"Honestly, I thought you were flawless. But thank you for showing me this side."

day4_night_seoyeon_accept_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_accept_2.text: "I'll never forget those words. That's a promise."

day4_night_seoyeon_gf_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_gf_2.text: "My heart's about to explode. You can't just drop that out of nowhere..."

day4_night_seoyeon_honest_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_honest_2.text: "From now on, I won't put on an act around you. Promise."

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_2.text: "I'm going to tell Mom. That I want to be myself before being 'the perfect daughter.'"

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_3.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_3.text: "...I was kind of a mess tonight. I'll make up for it tomorrow."

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_4.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_4.text: "A mess? I like this version of you better."

day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_end.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_resolve_end.text: "...You mean that? Remember -- you're completely mine now. Say that to another girl and you're dead."

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell.text: *We left the park and walked home together. Seoyeon held onto my arm and wouldn't let go.*

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_2.text: "I showed you my ugly side, but you didn't run. Points restored."

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_3.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_3.text: "You know if you run, I'm coming after you."

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_5.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_5.text: *Seoyeon turned to go, smiling. Cool and sweet at the same time.*

day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_6.name: Seoyeon
day4_night_seoyeon_farewell_6.text: "...Today was the first time I felt like 'it's okay to be me.' Thank you."

day4_night_seoyeon_home.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_home.text: *Back home. Seoyeon's tears keep flashing before me. The real face behind the perfect student council president. I want to help carry that weight.*

day4_night_seoyeon_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_seoyeon_home_2.text: *Tomorrow, I want her smile to come from the heart -- not from acting.*

day4_night_dain_gym.name: Me
day4_night_dain_gym.text: *9:30 PM. A message from Dain. 'Hey you free rn lol?? Can you come to school??'*

day4_night_dain_gym_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_gym_2.text: *Immediately followed by: 'Nvm just come lol! Gym back door is open!'*

day4_night_dain_gym_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_gym_3.text: *The gym at this hour? Something's off, but let's go check.*

day4_night_dain_arrive.name: Me
day4_night_dain_arrive.text: *I stepped inside the gym. Only emergency lights lit the dark court. Dain was alone, bouncing a volleyball.*

day4_night_dain_arrive_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_arrive_2.text: "OH!! You actually came?! That's my boyfriend!!"

day4_night_dain_arrive_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_arrive_3.text: *But something feels off. Like Dain's forcing her smile harder than usual.*

day4_night_dain_spike.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_spike.text: "Toss for me!! Just once!! Let me show you my spike!!"

day4_night_dain_spike_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_spike_2.text: *I tossed the ball. Dain leapt high and slammed the spike down.*

day4_night_dain_spike_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_spike_3.text: *The moment she landed -- Dain grabbed her right knee and crumpled down.*

day4_night_dain_hurt_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_hurt_3.text: "Nah nah!! I'm fine!! Just tweaked it a little lol, no biggie..."

day4_night_dain_hurt_4.name: Me
day4_night_dain_hurt_4.text: *Dain is smiling, but the hand gripping her knee has gone white.*
choices: "Don't lie to me. Let me see."
"Dain. You're not okay."

day4_night_dain_check.name: Me
day4_night_dain_check.text: *When I tried to look at her knee, Dain flinched and scrambled back.*

day4_night_dain_secret.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret.text: "...Fine. I was trying to hide it."

day4_night_dain_secret_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_secret_2.text: *Dain rolled up her knee brace. Her knee was badly swollen.*

day4_night_dain_secret_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret_3.text: "Anterior cruciate ligament. Tore it last year. Had surgery, but it never fully healed."

day4_night_dain_secret_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret_5.text: "The doctor said, 'Daily life is fine, but playing like before -- that's too much.'"

day4_night_dain_secret_6.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_secret_6.text: "Athletic scholarship, going pro... all of it. Gone."

day4_night_dain_dream.name: Me
day4_night_dain_dream.text: *For Dain, whose whole world was volleyball -- that was basically a death sentence.*

day4_night_dain_dream_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_2.text: "...You know how I always put on a bright face? Nobody knows it's an act."

day4_night_dain_dream_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_3.text: "'Dain is always so full of energy!' Every time I heard that, it was hilarious. Meanwhile my knee was on fire every single day."

day4_night_dain_dream_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_4.text: "Even on our date today, it hurt when we were running around. But I didn't want to show it."

day4_night_dain_dream_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_dream_5.text: "I know I need to give it up. But I just wanted to jump one more time. On this court."

day4_night_dain_cry.name: Me
day4_night_dain_cry.text: *Dain hugged the volleyball tight and lowered her head. Her shoulders shaking. The girl who was always bright and cheerful -- crying.*

day4_night_dain_cry_choice.name: Me
choices: "Volleyball isn't your only dream. Let's find a new one together."
"It's okay to cry. You don't have to fake being fine. Not with me."
"...Want me to toss one more? One last time."

day4_night_dain_future_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_future_2.text: "...Like coaching, or training. I do love teaching people."

day4_night_dain_future_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_future_3.text: "You'd be the most passionate coach on the planet."

day4_night_dain_future_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_future_4.text: "...Dummy, say stuff like that and I'll start crying again..."

day4_night_dain_tears_ok_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_tears_ok_2.text: "...You idiot... if you say that... I'll actually cry...!!"

day4_night_dain_tears_ok_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_tears_ok_3.text: *Dain buried her face in my chest and started sobbing. Her cries echoed through the empty gym.*

day4_night_dain_tears_ok_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_tears_ok_4.text: "...I couldn't tell anyone... every day, alone... I was so scared..."

day4_night_dain_last_spike_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_last_spike_2.text: "Not 'last' -- 'the final one before a fresh start.'"

day4_night_dain_last_spike_3.name: Me
day4_night_dain_last_spike_3.text: *I tossed the ball. Dain gritted her teeth, leapt, and slammed down the best spike I'd ever seen. She grabbed her knee on landing -- but she was smiling.*

day4_night_dain_last_spike_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_last_spike_4.text: "...Haha. It hurts. But it felt incredible."

day4_night_dain_last_spike_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_last_spike_5.text: "...Thank you. I think I can really let it go now."

day4_night_dain_resolve_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_resolve_2.text: "I've decided. I'm going to talk to my doctor properly and focus on rehab."

day4_night_dain_resolve_3.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_resolve_3.text: "But if I can never play volleyball again... you're taking responsibility. Got it?"

day4_night_dain_resolve_end.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_resolve_end.text: "Not joking. You're mine now. Don't even think about running."

day4_night_dain_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_dain_farewell.text: *We left the gym. Dain clung to my arm tight and wouldn't let go.*

day4_night_dain_farewell_2.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_2.text: "Hey, I almost cried because of you tonight lol. But weirdly, I don't feel bad about it."

day4_night_dain_farewell_4.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_4.text: "...LOL hey, that's supposed to be a secret!"

day4_night_dain_farewell_5.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_5.text: "But thank you. Really. Without you, I would've carried this alone forever."

day4_night_dain_farewell_6.name: Dain
day4_night_dain_farewell_6.text: "Starting tomorrow, I'll smile for real. Not the fake kind."

day4_night_dain_home.name: Me
day4_night_dain_home.text: *Back home. Dain in the gym keeps replaying. The pain hidden behind that constant brightness.*

day4_night_dain_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_dain_home_2.text: *Tomorrow, I want it to be a day Dain smiles from the heart. I'll be right there watching.*

day4_night_teacher_call_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_call_2.text: "...It's me. Is now a bad time?"

day4_night_teacher_call_3.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_call_3.text: *Her voice sounds different. Not the confident classroom version -- something tired underneath.*

day4_night_teacher_call_4.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_call_4.text: "You know the cafe near school? Let's meet there for a bit."

day4_night_teacher_cafe.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_cafe.text: *I arrived at the cafe. Teacher was sitting in a corner. Casual clothes.*

day4_night_teacher_cafe_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_cafe_2.text: "Thanks for coming. Sorry for calling you out like this."

day4_night_teacher_cafe_3.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_cafe_3.text: *Her eyes are red. Was she crying?*
choices: "Did something happen?"
Hand her coffee and wait quietly

day4_night_teacher_concern.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_concern.text: "...Not so much something happening. I just... did a lot of thinking today."

day4_night_teacher_wait.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_wait.text: "...Thank you. Just sitting next to me without a word -- I really like that about you."

day4_night_teacher_open.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open.text: "At yesterday's faculty meeting, the vice principal said, 'Be careful about getting too personally close to students.'"

day4_night_teacher_open_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_2.text: "Maybe it wasn't about us specifically. But my heart nearly stopped."

day4_night_teacher_open_3.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_3.text: "I'm a teacher. Your homeroom teacher. I know I shouldn't be doing this."

day4_night_teacher_open_5.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_5.text: "But walking home, I kept thinking about you. 'What's he doing right now?' 'Did he eat?'..."

day4_night_teacher_open_6.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_open_6.text: "Am I unfit to be a teacher? Or is it because these feelings are real that I'm this torn?"

day4_night_teacher_tear.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_tear.text: *She gripped her coffee cup tight and lowered her head. Her shoulders trembled faintly.*

day4_night_teacher_tear_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_tear_2.text: "...Ha, sorry. A teacher shouldn't be like this in front of a student."

day4_night_teacher_tear_choice.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_tear_choice.text: *Tears glistened at the corners of her eyes.*
choices: Hold her hand
"Right now, you're not a teacher -- you're a woman I can see as just that"

day4_night_teacher_hold_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_hold_2.text: *Under the table, I took her hand. Her cold fingers slowly grew warm.*

day4_night_teacher_hold_3.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_hold_3.text: "...We shouldn't be doing this here. Someone could see."

day4_night_teacher_hold_4.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_hold_4.text: "...But I don't want to let go."

day4_night_teacher_woman_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_woman_2.text: "Before you're a teacher, you're a person. It's okay to cry when you need to."

day4_night_teacher_woman_4.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_woman_4.text: "Say stuff like that and I'll actually start crying, you dummy."

day4_night_teacher_real.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_real.text: "...When I first became a teacher, I swore I'd never develop feelings for a student."

day4_night_teacher_real_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_real_2.text: "But you came along and tore that resolve apart without me even noticing."

day4_night_teacher_real_3.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_real_3.text: "I scolded you for being late, and you just smiled and said, 'You look tired today, are you okay?' instead."

day4_night_teacher_real_choice.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_real_choice.text: *Her voice is trembling as she speaks from the heart.*
choices: "After I graduate, I'll stand proudly by your side"
"This moment right now is precious. That's enough for me"
"If this is too hard, it's okay to stop"

day4_night_teacher_graduate_3.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_graduate_3.text: "I'm not waiting -- I'm becoming someone even better by then."

day4_night_teacher_graduate_4.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_graduate_4.text: "...God, you're way more grown-up than I am."

day4_night_teacher_present_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_present_2.text: "Tomorrow's problems can wait. Right now, I just want to be here with you."

day4_night_teacher_present_3.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_present_3.text: "...Yeah. Right now, this time together is what matters."

day4_night_teacher_give_up_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_give_up_2.text: "Dummy. I'm not struggling because I want to stop."

day4_night_teacher_give_up_3.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_give_up_3.text: "It's because these feelings are real -- that's what scares me."

day4_night_teacher_resolve_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_resolve_2.text: "I've made up my mind. At school I'm your teacher, but in moments like this, I'm just me."

day4_night_teacher_resolve_3.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_resolve_3.text: "A student shouldn't be saying things like that... me too, you idiot."

day4_night_teacher_resolve_end.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_resolve_end.text: "Don't get too friendly with the other girls at school. I have the authority to dock your grades, you know. ...Kidding. Half kidding."

day4_night_teacher_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_farewell.text: *We left the cafe. Walking side by side down the night street. She slipped her hand into mine.*

day4_night_teacher_farewell_2.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_farewell_2.text: "At school, I'm the strict teacher again. You know that, right?"

day4_night_teacher_farewell_4.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_farewell_4.text: "...So be careful. You're terrible at hiding how you feel in your eyes."

day4_night_teacher_farewell_5.name: Teacher
day4_night_teacher_farewell_5.text: "...No sleeping in class tomorrow. Got it?"

day4_night_teacher_home.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_home.text: *Back home. Teacher at the cafe keeps replaying. The always confident person showing me her vulnerability.*

day4_night_teacher_home_2.name: Me
day4_night_teacher_home_2.text: *This secret is heavy, but equally precious. I won't take her feelings lightly.*

day4_night_nurse_msg.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg.text: *10 PM. A message from the nurse. 'Still up? Can you come out for a bit if you have time?'*

day4_night_nurse_msg_2.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg_2.text: *Same playful tone as always, but this late? Something's different.*

day4_night_nurse_msg_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg_3.text: *I replied right away. 'Where should I go?'*

day4_night_nurse_msg_4.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_msg_4.text: *'The nurse's office at school. I'll leave the back door open.' ...The nurse's office?*

day4_night_nurse_arrive.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_arrive.text: *I arrived at the school. Opened the nurse's office door -- a dark room with only a desk lamp on. She was there.*

day4_night_nurse_arrive_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_arrive_2.text: "Wow, you actually came. Even at this hour?"

day4_night_nurse_arrive_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_arrive_3.text: *She's smiling as usual, but dark circles under her eyes. Several empty coffee cans on the desk.*
choices: "You look really tired"
"What's the real reason you called me here?"

day4_night_nurse_tired.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_tired.text: "Yeah? Guess it's been a hectic week. It's nothing, really."

day4_night_nurse_real_reason.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_real_reason.text: "...The real reason? ...I wanted to see you."

day4_night_nurse_mask.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_mask.text: *She's smiling, but something feels forced underneath.*

day4_night_nurse_mask_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_2.text: "...Something kind of rough happened at school today."

day4_night_nurse_mask_3.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_3.text: "The other teachers said, 'The nurse is always so cheerful -- must be nice having no worries.'"

day4_night_nurse_mask_4.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_4.text: "'No worries.' That one hurt the most."

day4_night_nurse_mask_5.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_5.text: "I was struggling too, and nobody asked. Not once. Not a single 'are you okay?'"

day4_night_nurse_mask_6.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_mask_6.text: "I smile for the students, take care of them. But who takes care of me?"

day4_night_nurse_lonely.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_lonely.text: "...When I go home, there's nobody. I live alone."

day4_night_nurse_lonely_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_lonely_2.text: "So I started staying late at school. At least in this nurse's office, I don't feel as alone."

day4_night_nurse_lonely_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_lonely_3.text: *Her smile faded. For the first time, her real face -- no jokes, no playfulness.*

day4_night_nurse_lonely_choice.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_lonely_choice.text: *I can see the real her now.*
choices: Sit beside her and hold her
"From now on, I'll be the one to take care of you"

day4_night_nurse_hug_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_hug_2.text: "Hey, out of nowhere... what are you..."

day4_night_nurse_hug_3.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_hug_3.text: *She was startled at first, but soon gripped my shirt tight.*

day4_night_nurse_hug_4.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_hug_4.text: "...This is strange. Have I ever wanted someone to hold me like this?"

day4_night_nurse_hug_5.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_hug_5.text: "...Let's stay like this. Just a little while."

day4_night_nurse_care_2.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_care_2.text: "You always take care of everyone else. Now it's your turn."

day4_night_nurse_care_3.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_care_3.text: "...How do you always hit right where it counts."

day4_night_nurse_truth.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth.text: "...Actually, there's a reason I became a school nurse."

day4_night_nurse_truth_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_2.text: "In high school, a close friend got sick and missed school for a long time. The school nurse back then really looked after her."

day4_night_nurse_truth_3.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_3.text: "I wanted to be someone like that. Someone who's on the side of hurting kids."

day4_night_nurse_truth_4.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_4.text: "But in reality, people just saw me as 'the nurse who jokes around.' Not a real teacher."

day4_night_nurse_truth_5.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_5.text: "They said being serious killed the vibe, so I naturally started hiding behind laughs."

day4_night_nurse_truth_6.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_truth_6.text: "...I did the same with you. Approached you with jokes and teasing. Showing my real feelings was terrifying."

day4_night_nurse_truth_choice.name: Me
choices: "The playful you and the real you -- I like all of it"
"Thank you for showing me the real you"
"You don't have to be scared anymore. I'm here"

day4_night_nurse_accept_all_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_accept_all_2.text: "You're the first person who's ever said that to me."

day4_night_nurse_accept_all_3.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_accept_all_3.text: "First time, so I don't even know how to react."

day4_night_nurse_thanks_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_thanks_2.text: "I didn't know being honest with you could feel this easy."

day4_night_nurse_safe_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_safe_2.text: "Maybe you're the person I feel most at ease with."

day4_night_nurse_resolve_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_resolve_2.text: "From now on, no mask around you. Promise."

day4_night_nurse_resolve_3.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_resolve_3.text: "I knew... I feel the same way. So if you're ever hurting, come straight to me."

day4_night_nurse_resolve_end.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_resolve_end.text: "If you go somewhere else, I'll be genuinely mad. For real."

day4_night_nurse_farewell.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_farewell.text: *We left the nurse's office and walked out of the school. She held my arm lightly and wouldn't let go.*

day4_night_nurse_farewell_2.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_2.text: "When you come to school tomorrow, stop by the nurse's office first. Attendance check."

day4_night_nurse_farewell_4.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_4.text: "...Around you, I keep getting honest. That's not like me at all."

day4_night_nurse_farewell_5.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_5.text: "At school, I'll act normal again. But my eyes won't be able to hide it."

day4_night_nurse_farewell_6.name: Nurse
day4_night_nurse_farewell_6.text: "When you walk past the nurse's office... just glance in. Once."

day4_night_nurse_home.name: Me
day4_night_nurse_home.text: *Back home. Her real face in the nurse's office keeps replaying. The person who always joked and laughed -- was actually the loneliest one of all.*

day4_night_regret.name: Me
day4_night_regret.text: *...I could have said it today. Under that sunset, it was the perfect moment.*

day4_night_regret_2.name: Me
day4_night_regret_2.text: *It's okay. There's tomorrow. Tomorrow, for sure.*

day4_night_regret_msg.name: Me
day4_night_regret_msg.text: *A message on my phone. "Today was fun. Are you free tomorrow too?"*

day4_night_regret_reply.name: Me
day4_night_regret_reply.text: *"Yeah, let's meet tomorrow." I'll definitely say it tomorrow.*

day4_night_reflect.name: Me
day4_night_reflect.text: *And just like that, Saturday passed. What will tomorrow bring?*

day4_night_sleep.name: Me
day4_night_sleep.text: *Closing my eyes, their face appears. Wouldn't mind falling asleep like this.*

day4_final.name: Me
day4_final.text: *Saturday night deepens. Tomorrow is Sunday -- the last day.*
